question: Where is the nearest café along the direction of travel from City Suites Hotel, Chicago, IL to Heritage Museum and Cultural Center, Saint Joseph, MI?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%City Suites Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Heritage Museum and Cultural Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Saint Joseph%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MI%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_azimuth AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geom, ep.geom)) AS bearing FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, travel_azimuth ta WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' -- Limit the search to cafes within 100 km of the starting point for efficiency and relevance AND ST_DWithin(sp.geom::geography, p.geometry::geography, 100000) -- Filter cafes that are within +/- 45 degrees of the direct travel bearing AND ( LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geom, p.geometry)) - ta.bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geom, p.geometry)) - ta.bearing) ) < 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
